name: East China University of Technology
supervisors: Jiangxi Provincial Government (co-built with SASTIND, the Ministry of Natural Resources and CNNC)

evidence.summary: ECUT, founded in 1956 as the first higher-education institution of China’s nuclear industry, is co-built by the Jiangxi government with SASTIND, the Ministry of Natural Resources and the state nuclear group CNNC.
It reports five national defence-specialty disciplines (国家国防特色学科) and a defence innovation research centre for radioactive geology and exploration technology.
